verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a SaaS app, an open-source CLI and MCP servers, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents such a control for the CLI, MCP or web product. The AI-usage ingestion API (ramp-supp-ai-usage-tracking) is about customers sending their own AI spend data into Ramp, which is a different feature and gives no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
